detail: Three initial invocations returned no MCP tool response. Collector had unverified canopy alias PERIMETER_CANOPY and a missing nested closing brace; correcting only the alias did not repair syntax. Actual native inventory proves BUFFER_CANOPIES; balanced corrected collector succeeded. No model writes. First error explanation was provisional, syntax was subsequently confirmed.
Current partial middle slab already leaves30x11mvoid. Nine native controls confirm open; visible upper slab/retained beams do not prove closed middle floor.
